title: VNS3NV04DPTR-E
content: The test conditions of VINCL parameters of VNS3V04DPTR-E chip are: Does light inject 1mA current into the IN pin, and does the SOURCE pin need to be grounded?

scraped_replies.html:
Welcome ​@7589545, to the community!

The test parameters for VINCL specified in table 6 of the VNS3V04DPTR-E datasheet refer to the protection diode at VIN. In this case, a current of 1 mA, or a reverse current of -1 mA, is applied, with the respective source pin serving as the opposite terminal.

In this respect, I can answer your questions with yes and yes.

Does it answer your question?

Regards
/Peter
Thank you for your answer. I also want to ask, when testing this test item, do other pins of the chip have to be suspended?

I only have the test circuits from the datasheet as well, but I assume that when testing the input diode, only the relevant input and source pins are used, and the other pins remain open.
Regards
/Peter
